decisions.reason: As a homepage-promoted next-generation printer in the firm’s core marking business, it appears strategically important and proven enough to justify continued commitment.
This software module extends the existing inline printing offer and is likely inexpensive to maintain, so its option value remains attractive even if demand is somewhat niche.
After several years it showed only limited visibility and, as a more specialized hardware variant, it likely ties up more resources than a still-uncertain niche opportunity should.
The app supports the firm’s digitalization and traceability direction and should be relatively low-cost to keep on the market as a complementary ecosystem tool.
Inline code verification fits directly with serialization and end-to-end traceability, making it a strategically valuable complement to the firm’s installed coding systems.
A homepage-featured print layout software strengthens the one-stop solution bundle and is a low-cost digital complement worth retaining.
